strongest_angle: An October 2026 intelligence watchdog report by Lord Leveson revealed that MI5 provided false evidence and lied to three courts while defending a violent neo-Nazi spy known as agent X.

key_facts.fact: Investigatory powers commissioner Lord Leveson stated that MI5 lying to multiple courts while defending a violent neo-Nazi spy is as serious as anything he has ever dealt with.
The Investigatory Powers Commissioner's Office (IPCO) investigated how MI5 gave false evidence to three courts concerning the abusive informant known as agent X.
MI5 accepted that it gave evidence based on lies to three courts and that senior security service officers were repeatedly dishonest.
Sir Brian Leveson expressed being disappointed and concerned that a number of government bodies failed to follow safeguards in their use of surveillance and covert powers.

numbers.label: Number of courts misled by MI5 false evidence

quotes.text: The man responsible for overseeing the conduct of the UK's intelligence services has said that MI5 lying to multiple courts while defending a violent neo-Nazi spy is as "serious as anything" he has ever dealt with.
